name: wayfinder
description: Wayfinder - 2,300+ real places worth going, ticked off together.

scripts.check: python tools/check_geography.py && python tools/check_code.py && python tools/check_quality.py && python tools/check_sql.py
scripts.sync: npm run stage && npx cap sync
scripts.android:aab: npm run stage && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run stage && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
